240	blessing.	bênção.
241	So there should be blessing on the table: bread and salt is always good too.	Por isso, para haver bênção na mesa, pão e sal sempre é bom também.
242	Za'atar, za'atar.	Zaatar, zaatar.
243	Za'atar is good too.	Zaatar também é bom.
244	Great, you understand segulot, baruch HaShem.	Ótimo, você entende de segulot, graças a HaShem.
245	So now, doing this, this is the blessing, he will have
246	blessing all the days of the week, that is the blessing.	bênção todos os dias da semana, essa é a bênção.
247	How did they replace the bread?	Como trocavam o pão?
248	They would put one loaf here, then they would bring the second loaf and put it
249	next to it, push this one out, and bring this one in.	ao lado, empurravam este para fora e traziam este para dentro.
250	So what happened was that there was not even one second of an empty table.	Assim, não havia nem um segundo sequer de mesa vazia.
251	There is no empty table.	Não há mesa vazia.
252	Now this bread, the old bread, they would divide among the cohanim who served in that
253	shift, and bring it to them to eat.	turno, e levavam para eles comerem.
254	Rabenu the Rambam writes that this bread would diminish
255	their evil inclination.	o impulso mau deles.
256	That is, it was a segulah: since they were holy men, serving in holiness in the Beit HaMikdash, the
257	evil inclination would come and accuse them, wanting to make them fall from their holiness so they would not serve in the Beit HaMikdash, so their inclination
258	is high.	é elevado.
259	Sukkah 52: whoever is greater than his fellow, his inclination is greater than his.	Sucá 52: quem é maior que o seu companheiro, seu impulso é maior que o dele.
260	So with such a high inclination, how could they serve the Holy One, Blessed be He, if the inclination is so hard?	Com um impulso tão elevado, como poderiam servir o Santo, Bendito seja, se o impulso é tão duro?
261	So there was no choice, they needed to receive some segulah from HaShem
262	to lower their evil inclination.	para rebaixar o impulso mau deles.
263	What would they do?	O que faziam?
264	They would receive from the bread; when they ate the bread, their evil inclination
265	would go down.	descia.
266	In this generation you would need how many kilos, how many tons of bread to lower the evil inclination, why it
267	accuses the person.	acusa a pessoa.
268	The Gemara says, what does one get in one shift of the cohanim?	Diz a Guemará: o que cabe a cada um em um turno dos cohanim?
269	Tasty, Moshe, tasty.	Gostoso, Moshe, gostoso.
270	What does one get in one shift of the cohanim?	O que cabe a cada um em um turno dos cohanim?
271	Without the evil eye, may you be healthy.	Sem mau-olhado, que você tenha saúde.
272	Does it lower the evil inclination, or raise it?	Isso rebaixa o impulso mau ou o eleva?
273	That is the question.	Essa é a pergunta.
274	What happened in one shift of the cohanim, who divided
275	the bread among themselves?	o pão entre si?
276	And one of them — there were many cohanim, so they divided the bread, and one received only the size of a grain of
277	bean.	feijão.
278	He said, ah...	Ele disse: ah...
279	Look what I got, the size of a grain of bean.	Olhe o que recebi, do tamanho de um grão de feijão.
280	His fellow said to him, say thank you, I received the size of a lizard's tail.	O companheiro disse: agradeça, eu recebi do tamanho de uma cauda de lagartixa.
281	Tiny, tiny.	Pequenininho.
282	Immediately the cohanim were alarmed.	Na mesma hora os cohanim se alarmaram.
283	What, what did he say?	O quê, o que ele disse?
284	What did he say?	O que ele disse?
285	Like a lizard's tail?	Cauda de lagartixa?
286	They investigated him and found that he was a mamzer.	Investigaram-no e descobriram que ele era um mamzer.
287	You would speak this way, an impure thing, about the bread?	Você fala assim, algo impuro, sobre o pão?
288	You would say "like a lizard's tail"?	Você diz "como cauda de lagartixa"?
289	Woe, if today they checked what we say, what we all, what we let out
290	of the mouth.	da boca.
291	Bava Kama 38b, the Gemara says that the younger one said "Ammon" and the elder one said "Moav,"
292	and about the one who said "Moav," "from my father," and she was not ashamed.	e sobre a que disse "Moav", "de meu pai", e não teve vergonha.
293	To say she became pregnant from her father — Moshe Rabenu said, come, let us go against Moav, besiege
294	them. Why must a person choose his words, so that he does not say ugly or bad words?	eles. Por que o homem deve escolher suas palavras, para não dizer palavras feias ou más?
295	It testifies to what is inside, whether he is pure or impure: it is what he brings out of his mouth. Ah, and so
296	you light the lamps: two ears that do not want to hear only bad things, two	você acende as lâmpadas: dois ouvidos que não querem ouvir só coisas ruins, dois
297	eyes that do not stray after their hearts to see nonsense, two nostrils that do not get angry, burning anger,	olhos que não se desviam atrás do coração para ver bobagens, duas narinas que não se enchem de ira, de raiva ardente,
298	or smell the perfumes of women or the incense of idolatry, and above all, the mouth, the	nem sentem os perfumes das mulheres ou o incenso da idolatria, e acima de tudo, a boca, o
299	body of the menorah. If this whole menorah is clean and pure, then you	corpo da menorá. Se toda esta menorá está limpa e pura, então você
300	light up for the Holy One, Blessed be He, the way to you, and contentment comes upon you,	ilumina para o Santo, Bendito seja, o caminho até você, e vem sobre você satisfação,
301	and tranquility, and livelihood, and a good wife, and good decrees, long life,	e serenidade, e sustento, e uma boa esposa, e bons decretos, longevidade,
302	if everything shines.	se tudo brilha.
303	But if you put out the lamps, you will see darkness, and when there is
304	darkness, the kelipot come and make his life miserable.	escuridão, as klipot vêm e tornam a vida dele miserável.
305	No, he has no joy in life, he hates himself, he feels like a loser.	Não, ele não tem alegria na vida, odeia a si mesmo, sente-se um perdedor.
306	It does not matter that he may be the most successful in the world, he feels like zero, he cannot overcome
307	himself, and that is because he commits transgressions and puts out the lamps of his face.	a si mesmo, e isso é porque ele comete transgressões e apaga as lâmpadas do seu rosto.
308	Afterwards, in this parashah, the people of Israel manage to make a mess once again.	Depois, nesta parashá, o povo de Israel consegue fazer uma bagunça mais uma vez.
309	Why?	Por quê?
310	They ask again for bread, meat, "we remember the garlic." What they whined about before, that was
311	the mixed multitude, who incited them.	o Erev Rav, que os incitava.
312	They did everything, so that...	Eles fizeram de tudo, então isso...
313	Moshe Rabenu already throws up his hands: enough, I cannot anymore.	Moshe Rabenu já levanta as mãos: chega, não aguento mais.
314	"Did I conceive all this people, all this people?"	"Fui eu que concebi todo este povo, todo este povo?"
315	"Did I give birth to them, that You say to me, carry them in your bosom, as the nurse carries the suckling child?"	"Fui eu que os dei à luz, para que me digas: leva-os ao teu colo, como o tutor leva o lactente?"
316	What is Moshe Rabenu saying here?	O que Moshe Rabenu está dizendo aqui?
317	Why did he bring us now a parable about a nursling and childbirth?	Por que trouxe agora uma parábola sobre o lactente e o parto?
318	Rather, what is it?	Mas então, o que é?
319	When the baby cries and the mother is next to him, she soothes him in one second.	Quando o bebê chora e a mãe está ao lado, ela o acalma num segundo.
320	She takes this out, lets him nurse, and then the baby is soothed.	Tira o peito, deixa-o mamar, e então o bebê se acalma.
321	A baby always loves to nurse, that is the rule.	Bebê sempre adora mamar, essa é a regra.
322	So he is soothed, stops crying.	Então ele se acalma, para de chorar.
323	But when a nanny comes who did not give birth, who has no milk, she has no
324	way to soothe the baby.	como acalmar o bebê.
325	She tries rocking him, nothing helps.	Tenta embalá-lo, nada ajuda.
326	She tries giving him a pacifier, nothing helps.	Tenta dar a chupeta, nada ajuda.
327	She changes him, burps him, nothing.	Troca a fralda, tira os gases da barriga, nada.
328	He keeps crying, why? Because he is hungry.	Ele continua chorando, por quê? Porque está com fome.
329	And back then there was no formula, so now the child, there is no one to soothe him.	E naquela época não havia fórmula, então agora a criança, não há quem a acalme.
330	This is what Moshe Rabenu is saying.	É isto que Moshe Rabenu está dizendo.
331	Did I conceive all this people?	Fui eu que concebi todo este povo?
332	Are they my children?	São eles os meus filhos?
333	"Did I give birth to them, that You say to me, carry them in your bosom, as the nurse carries the suckling child?"	"Fui eu que os dei à luz, para que me digas: leva-os ao teu colo, como o tutor leva o lactente?"
334	But I am a nurse.	Mas eu sou um tutor.
335	I did not give birth to this people.	Eu não dei à luz este povo.
336	If I had given birth to this people, I would have a way to soothe them.	Se eu tivesse dado à luz este povo, teria como acalmá-lo.
337	I am only the nurse.	Eu sou apenas o tutor.
338	And the nurse cannot soothe this people.	E o tutor não consegue acalmar este povo.
339	"As the nurse carries the suckling child": he needs to nurse.	"Como o tutor leva o lactente": ele precisa mamar.
340	And I have nothing with which to nourish him.	E eu não tenho com o que alimentá-lo.
341	This is the claim of Moshe Rabenu.	Esta é a queixa de Moshe Rabenu.
342	And about this it is said there, before it: "And the mixed multitude among them
343	craved a craving, and the children of Israel also wept again."	teve um desejo ardente, e também os filhos de Israel voltaram a chorar."
344	Who is the mixed multitude, the Erev Rav?	Quem é o "asafsuf", o Erev Rav?
345	May their name be erased. To this day they are there on some hill in Jerusalem. Soon our righteous Mashiach will come
346	home, to sort things out.	para casa, para fazer os acertos.
347	And we will see who is Amalek, there are also Amalekim.	E veremos quem é Amalek, também há amalecitas.
348	The Amalekim, and there are all kinds, there are five types of Amalek. The Zohar writes it twice, both in the Zohar Bereshit and
349	in Zohar Bereshit 25a and Zohar Chadash 40.	no Zohar Bereshit 25a e no Zohar Chadash 40.
350	Twice the Zohar writes that there are five types of Amalek.	Duas vezes o Zohar escreve que há cinco tipos de Amalek.
351	There are Amalekim who cause Israel to sin in forbidden relations; there are Amalekim who take over the people of
352	Israel and build synagogues and batei midrash and place a Sefer
353	Torah there to be a crown on their heads.	Torá ali para ser uma coroa sobre as suas cabeças.
354	Do you hear what the Zohar writes?	Você ouve o que o Zohar escreve?
355	That there are synagogues of the Amalekim.	Que há sinagogas dos amalecitas.
356	There are still more like these.	Ainda há outros assim.
357	Do you understand, may He have mercy on us, what a generation.	Você entende? Que Ele tenha misericórdia de nós, que geração.
358	Unbelievable, what the Zohar writes.	Inacreditável o que o Zohar escreve.
359	Open it up. I am not going to give sources for you on the channel, but I know them.	Abram e vejam. Não vou dar as fontes aqui no canal, mas eu as conheço.
